items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I have in writing, or in Blackstone has in writing, an answer to this article I wrote in his magazine, from B. Palmer, saying that every word of it was true

ctx.x: B. Palmer, yeah. Well, as I say, Bix and Trombaugh and Snoozer were over at her house. Some of the Whiteman boys, the jazz department of Whiteman, was over at B. Palmer's house one Sunday afternoon, and they were playing around, and first thing you know, B. Palmer caught a whiff of this guitar, you know? And she listened to him a little while, and she finally said to Bix and Trombaugh, I know what you fellas can do. Could I get a little bit of this guitar by himself and see what he sounds like? And so they…
